# Native Title

## Introduction

The High Court recognised native title.[^1] Commentators agree.[^2] So does a second author.[^3] Parliament legislated.[^4] International law is relevant.[^5]

[^1]: *Mabo v Queensland [No 2]* (1992) 175 CLR 1, 42.
[^2]: Lisa Strelein, *Compromised Jurisprudence: Native Title Cases since Mabo* (Aboriginal Studies Press, 2nd ed, 2009) 45.
[^3]: Richard Bartlett, 'The Proprietary Nature of Native Title' (1998) 6(2) *Australian Property Law Journal* 77, 80.
[^4]: *Native Title Act 1993* (Cth) s 223.
[^5]: *International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights*, opened for signature 16 December 1966, 999 UNTS 171 (entered into force 23 March 1976) art 27.
